description: Mock implementation of a file system module for testing, including in-memory storage of files and directories, with functions to read, write, create directories, access, and rename files, as well as initial mock data setup.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a file from the in-memory mock file system, returning predefined content or rule files based on filename.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Asynchronously writes content to a file in the mock file system, creating parent directories as needed.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates directories in the mock file system, supporting recursive creation.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists in the mock file system.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames (moves) a file within the mock file system.

methods.name: _setInitialMockData
methods.description: Initializes default mock data, including MCP settings and directory structure.
